SELECT s.*, SHA1(s.id) AS hash_id, smm.cf_email_subscribers as cf_email_subscribers, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN smm.alert_mail_bcc != smm.cf_email_subscribers THEN smm.alert_mail_bcc END) as bcc_client_emails, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT case WHEN sem.is_hiding = 1 THEN e.email END) as hiding_emails, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT case WHEN em.id_role is not null THEN e.email END) as nw_emails FROM site AS s LEFT JOIN time_zone t ON t.id = s.id_time_zone LEFT JOIN site_mail_map smm ON smm.id_site = s.id LEFT JOIN site_employee_map sem on sem.id_site = s.id LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = sem.id_employee AND e.is_delete = 0 AND e.`status` = 1 LEFT JOIN employee_role_map em ON em.id_employee = e.id AND em.id_role in (1,12,15) WHERE s.`status` = 1 AND s.is_delete = 0 AND smm.cf_email_subscribers IS NOT NULL AND (CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', t.offset) < s.expiration OR s.expiration IS NULL)
AND s.id IN
#{site_id}
GROUP BY s.id

SELECT a.id, a.id_device, a.open_send_mail, a.close_send_mail, d.devicename as device_name, s.name as site_name, e.message, e.error_code, IF(a.`status` = 0, 'Closed', 'Opened') AS `status`, e.nw as is_notity_nw, e.client as is_notity_client, IF(a.start_date IS NULL , "-", DATE_FORMAT( CONVERT_TZ( a.start_date, '+00:00', t.`offset` ), '%m-%d-%Y %H:%i %p' ) ) AS start_date, IF(a.end_date IS NULL , "-", DATE_FORMAT( CONVERT_TZ( a.end_date, '+00:00', t.`offset` ), '%m-%d-%Y %H:%i %p' ) ) AS end_date FROM alert_new a LEFT JOIN error e ON e.id = a.id_error LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id = a.id_device LEFT JOIN site s ON s.id = d.id_site LEFT JOIN time_zone t ON t.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE d.`status` = 1 AND d.id_site = #{id_site}
AND a.open_send_mail = 0 AND a.`status` = 1
AND a.close_send_mail = 0 AND a.`status` = 0
AND e.id_error_level IN
#{level}
AND e.id_error_level IN ( SELECT id_error_level FROM error_level_site_map m WHERE m.id_site = #{id_site} GROUP BY m.id_error_level )
ORDER BY a.`status` DESC
